values.note: Every site except the designated tent sites has water and electric; 66 (in the South Campground) also have sewer. The park does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/huntington-beach/camping ('Each site, excluding the designated tent sites, has water and electrical hookups'; 'Full Hookup Sites with Elec, Water, Sewer: 66 sites') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/huntington-beach/campsites ('The South Campground also offers sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 173 sites in two campgrounds near the shore (107 water/electric, 66 full hookup), plus 6 walk-in rustic tent sites. Several sites take RVs up to 40 ft, others up to 30 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/huntington-beach/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 107 sites'; 'Full Hookup Sites ...: 66 sites'; 'Several sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet, others up to 30 feet'; '6 rustic tent sites') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/huntington-beach/campsites ('173, to be exact'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/huntington-beach/camping ('convenient to hot showers and restrooms'; 'Dump Station: Yes'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. The booking site's policy is a 2-night minimum ('Some parks have longer minimum stay requirements during peak season and holidays'); per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon. Discounted rates may be offered in low-demand seasons.

booking.source: https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/huntington-beach/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site') + https://southcarolinaparks.com/huntington-beach/camping (same-day via the park; 'Discounted rates may be available for seasons of lower demand'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (booking-site policy; now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver); added water at every RV site and sewer at 66 (amps not stated), 173 sites up to 40 ft, 14-night max, showers and dump. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. Not stated: amperage, season, pull-throughs.
